title: Change the plan together
task: Help a group change an agreed plan while keeping consent reversible and clear.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Consent Tide Ledger with Reaffirm Window
synthesis.action: Members set agree, unsure, or withdraw per change via drag, arrow keys, or buttons.
synthesis.feedback: Labeled states with text and icons, live-announced tallies, and undo history; never color alone.
synthesis.mechanism: Change locks only after quiet window with no unsure; any flip reopens; stalls prompt revision.
synthesis.difference: Consent is graded, time-bound, and reopenable, with uncertainty as explicit state rather than silence.
synthesis.risks: Quiet-member pressure, misread tentative states, and stalling; unsure count shown anonymously to reduce pressure.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, local state machine, ARIA live regions, fictional group data.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed keyboard test: testers predict who joins after edits; measure misreading and correction errors.

proposals.title: Consent Tokens on a Shared Plan Table
proposals.action: Each member places, moves, or withdraws their token on plan changes.
proposals.feedback: Changes show solid, faded, or open tokens per person.
proposals.mechanism: Faded tokens mark tentative consent; anyone can withdraw before lock-in.
proposals.difference: Consent is a visible, movable object, not a yes button.
proposals.risks: Faded tokens may be misread as agreement; social pressure persists.
proposals.feasibility: Single-device web prototype with fictional members and local state.
proposals.prototype: Clickable mockup: weekend trip plan, three proposed changes, undo history.

proposals.title: Consent Ledger with Pending Tokens
proposals.action: Members drag a token onto proposed plan change; drag back anytime.
proposals.feedback: Each token shows state: yes, unsure, no, or unseen.
proposals.mechanism: Change activates only when all tokens settle; any withdrawal reverts instantly.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is a visible token state, not hidden as silence.
proposals.risks: Token clutter in large groups; stalled plans from lingering unsure states.
proposals.feasibility: Single-page offline app with local state machine and undo log.
proposals.prototype: Fictional five-person picnic replan, timeline of reversible token moves.

proposals.title: Consent Tide Chart
proposals.action: Members drag personal markers along a plan-change timeline showing commitment strength.
proposals.feedback: Shared chart shows firm, tentative, and withdrawn stances with stated reasons.
proposals.mechanism: Consent decays to tentative unless reaffirmed before the change locks.
proposals.difference: Consent is graded and time-bound, not a single binary vote.
proposals.risks: Decay may confuse users or pressure quiet members to reaffirm.
proposals.feasibility: Local web prototype with fictional group and scripted plan changes.
proposals.prototype: Observe whether testers correctly predict who will join after edits.

proposals.title: Consent Ledger with Pending Tokens
proposals.action: Members hold tokens: agree, unsure, or withdraw on proposed changes.
proposals.feedback: Screen reader announces tally changes and who remains unsure, fictionally.
proposals.mechanism: Change activates only after quiet window; any token flip reopens it.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is a first-class state, not abstention or silence.
proposals.risks: Endless reopening may stall decisions; window length needs tuning.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with local state and ARIA live regions.
proposals.prototype: Keyboard-only test: arrow tokens, Escape undoes last, errors explained inline.

synthesis.title: Named Thread Ledger for Plan Changes
synthesis.action: Each named member ties, loosens, or unties their own thread on each proposed change.
synthesis.feedback: Per-member labels show tied, unsure, or untied; holdouts always named, with resource tradeoffs shown.
synthesis.mechanism: Change holds only while all threads stay tied; any untie instantly reopens it and logs it.
synthesis.difference: Consent is maintained, named, revocable tension per person, not a one-time aggregate vote.
synthesis.risks: Visible stances may pressure members; private unsure flag and delayed reveal mitigate but not eliminate.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline web page with fictional members, local state, and an undo log.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed clickable mockup: five fictional members, three changes, untie, private correction, and undo trail.

proposals.title: Stitched Plan Ledger
proposals.action: Members tie or loosen personal threads binding each plan change.
proposals.feedback: Each joint shows taut, slack, or frayed thread per member.
proposals.mechanism: Changes hold only while every thread stays tied; untying reopens joint.
proposals.difference: Consent becomes visible, maintained tension rather than one-time checkbox approval.
proposals.risks: Thread metaphor may confuse; social pressure to stay tied.
proposals.feasibility: Local web page with fictional members and simple state model.
proposals.prototype: Clickable offline mockup showing three changes, ties, frays, and repairs.

proposals.title: Consent Reservoir
proposals.action: Members pour or drain consent tokens into a shared plan-change tank.
proposals.feedback: Tank level rises with lag; murky water marks unconfirmed or stale consent.
proposals.mechanism: Consent flows in slowly and drains instantly, keeping withdrawal always reversible.
proposals.difference: Consent becomes a visible stock with flow, not one-time yes buttons.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may obscure who disagrees; murkiness could feel vague or coercive.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline web canvas with fictional members and local state.
proposals.prototype: Paper or HTML mockup testing drain, refill, and clarity labels.

proposals.title: Stage Marks for Plan Changes
proposals.action: Members drag tokens onto a shared stage toward proposed change.
proposals.feedback: Token distance shows lean; dashed outline marks unsure stance.
proposals.mechanism: Consent equals stepping onstage; stepping back withdraws instantly, logged visibly.
proposals.difference: Spatial proximity encodes consent strength and uncertainty, not binary votes.
proposals.risks: Distance may be misread; pressure from visible positions.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline web page with fictional members and local state.
proposals.prototype: Clickable mock: five fictional tokens, one plan change, undo trail.

proposals.title: Ration Ledger Tokens
proposals.action: Members slide personal tokens onto proposed habitat plan changes.
proposals.feedback: Each token shows confidence shading and expiry countdown visibly.
proposals.mechanism: Consent decays unless renewed; withdrawing token instantly flags dependent changes.
proposals.difference: Consent becomes physical, time-bound, and confidence-weighted, not binary.
proposals.risks: Decay may pressure members or obscure who still agrees.
proposals.feasibility: Offline tablet app with fictional crew and resource data.
proposals.prototype: Paper tokens on printed plan board, then clickable mockup.
